sections.title: Birthdays and Presents
sections.content: A birthday brings its own small set of words, and most of the verbs around it are regular ones you can already build: decorar, cantar, and escribir, which is the -ir verb from Lesson 6 put to work. Two fixed phrases are worth learning whole, because their verbs are irregular and you do not need them yet: 'soplar las velas' and 'pedir un deseo'.

items.spanish: Carlos sale temprano para comprar un pastel y unas bebidas.
items.english: Carlos goes out early to buy a cake and some drinks.

items.spanish: Kaylee decora la sala con globos de colores.
items.english: Kaylee decorates the living room with coloured balloons.

items.spanish: Todos cantan y Meg sopla las velas y pide un deseo.
items.english: Everyone sings, and Meg blows out the candles and makes a wish.

items.spanish: Es un cuaderno para escribir palabras nuevas en español.
items.english: It's a notebook for writing new Spanish words in.

sections.content: 'El cumpleaños' ends in -s but is singular — one birthday, 'el cumpleaños'; several, 'los cumpleaños'. The word itself never changes.
